5955.title: Unix provider updates bypass current-directory PATH entries
5955.rootCauseOneLine: Unconditional installer pre-resolution drops empty Unix PATH components, rejecting the current-directory executable or selecting a later installation.
5955.proposedFix: Limit installer pre-resolution to Windows and preserve native Unix lookup through node-pty; add real-process regression coverage for empty PATH components.
5955.caveats: Linux verified twice by the same agent. Windows and macOS were not run. Two unrelated host-suite environmental failures also occur on unchanged main. Reproduction code is embedded in the HTML in accordance with the reports repository policy.
